title: Cleopatra lived closer to the Moon landing than to the pyramids
summary: The Great Pyramid was already about 2,500 years old when Cleopatra was born — more time than separates her from Apollo 11. 'Ancient Egypt' spans roughly 3,000 years.
evidenceNote: Dates for the Great Pyramid are approximate (around 2600–2500 BCE), but the comparison holds across the whole range.

scenes.text: Who lived closer in time to the Moon landing: Cleopatra, or the builders of the Great Pyramid?

events.what: Great Pyramid of Giza is completed

scenes.text: To Cleopatra, the pyramids were already ancient — older to her than she is to us.
'Ancient Egypt' spans about 3,000 years. We squash it into one picture.
